MERGE (i:Issue {issueId: $issueId}) SET i.number = toInteger($number), i.title = $title, i.bodyText = $bodyText, i.createdAt = $createdAt, i.updatedAt = $updatedAt, i.closedAt = $closedAt, i.state = $state, i.authorLogin = $authorLogin RETURN i
UNWIND $users AS user MERGE (u:User {login: user.login}) SET u.name = user.name, u.company = user.company RETURN u.login AS login
MATCH (i:Issue {issueId: $issueId}), (u:User {login: $login}) MERGE (i)-[:AUTHORED_BY]->(u)
UNWIND $labels AS label MERGE (l:Label {name: label.name}) SET l.description = label.description, l.color = label.color RETURN l.name AS name
MATCH (i:Issue {issueId: $issueId}) UNWIND $names AS name MATCH (l:Label {name: name}) MERGE (i)-[:HAS_LABEL]->(l)
UNWIND $reactions AS reaction MERGE (r:Reaction {content: reaction.content, issueId: $issueId, userLogin: reaction.userLogin}) ON CREATE SET r.commentId = $commentId RETURN count(r) AS reactionCount
MATCH (i:Issue {issueId: $issueId}) MATCH (r:Reaction {issueId: $issueId}) WHERE r.commentId IS NULL MERGE (i)-[:HAS_REACTION]->(r)

UNWIND $comments AS c MERGE (comment:Comment {commentId: c.id}) SET comment.bodyText = c.bodyText, comment.createdAt = c.createdAt, comment.authorLogin = c.authorLogin WITH comment, c MATCH (i:Issue {issueId: $issueId}) MERGE (i)-[:HAS_COMMENT]->(comment) RETURN count(comment) AS cnt
UNWIND $users AS user MERGE (u:User {login: user.login}) SET u.name = user.name, u.company = user.company RETURN u.login AS login
UNWIND $items AS item MATCH (c:Comment {commentId: item.id}), (u:User {login: item.login}) MERGE (c)-[:AUTHORED_BY]->(u)
